#Introduction

This code aims to synthesize and visualize data collected on Biomass (kg/m2) and Mortality of plants in our NRCS Cuyama Valley Project. The Santa Barbara Botanic Garden, in partnership with Quail Springs, is tranforming 3 different farm sites into productive better-functioning habitat. 

In this analysis, we explore the relationship between different weed suprression and irrigation treatments, plant mortality, and plant growth. 

```{r}
# read in the data, make sure you have the most updated file
list.files("Raw Data") #list names of files


cuyama_data <- read.csv(here("Raw Data/CombinedBiomassData_June2026.csv")) %>%
  clean_names()

class(cuyama_data$width1_cm_widest_diameter)
str(cuyama_data$width1_cm_widest_diameter) #double checks columns are numberical not characters

#read in data for real now

cuyama_data <- read.csv(here("Raw Data/CombinedBiomassData_June2026_1.csv")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(species_id !="EMPTY") %>% 
  rename (width1_cm = width1_cm_widest_diameter,#renaming
          width2_cm = width2_cm_perpendicular_to_w1_measurement) %>% 
  mutate(width1_cm = as.numeric(width1_cm), #creates numerical columns
         width2_cm = as.numeric(width2_cm), 
         height_cm = as.numeric(height_cm),
         width1_m = width1_cm/100, #coverting to m from cm
         width2_m = width2_cm/100,
         height_m = height_cm/100) %>% 
  mutate(veg_type = case_when(species_id == "ASCERO" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "ASCFAS" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "ASCVES" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "ASTLEN" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "CALSP" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "CIROCC" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "CORFIL" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "CUCPAL" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "DATWRI" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "EPICAN" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "EPIGIG" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "HESWHI" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "MENLAE" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "OENELA" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "PENCEN" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "POASEC" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "SENFLA" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "STAPIN" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "STEPAU" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "STICER" ~ "herb",
                            species_id == "ATRCAN" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "EASELE" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "ENCFAR" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "ERILIN" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "ERITOM" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "ERIFAS" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "GUTCAL" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "ISOACR" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "LEPSQU" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "LONSUB" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "LUPALB" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "MALJON" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "PERARB" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "SALAPI" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "SALLEU" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "SALMEL" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "SAMMEX" ~ "shrub",
                            species_id == "QUEDOU" ~ "tree",
                            species_id == "QUEJOH" ~ "tree")) %>%
  mutate(mort_status = case_when(mortality_status == "A" ~ "1",
                                 mortality_status == "D" ~ "0"))

class(cuyama_data$mortality_status) #checks if character or numeric

cuyama_data$mort_status <- as.numeric(cuyama_data$mort_status) #changes to numeric

class(cuyama_data$mort_status) #should now show numeric

cuyama_data$date_lbd <- parse_date_time(cuyama_data$date, "ymd") #tells R that dates are in yyyy/mm/dd, and makes sure it is recognized as a date rather than a number

class(cuyama_data$date_lbd) #checks class of new column, should be date

class(cuyama_data$date) #checks class of original column, should be character

cuyama_data <- cuyama_data %>% 
  filter(date > "2026-05-01")#filter data to keep rows after set date; important after mupltiple rounds of data collection


```


```{r}
# grouping

class(cuyama_data$biomass_kg_m2)
str(cuyama_data$biomass_kg_m2) # check if character or numeric
  
cuyama_data <- cuyama_data %>%
  mutate(biomass_kg_m2 = as.numeric(biomass_kg_m2))# convert to numeric


cuyama_data <- cuyama_data %>% # substitute 0 for missing value
  mutate(biomass_kg_m2 = replace_na(biomass_kg_m2, 0))


# group by site and sum biomass
biomass_plot <- cuyama_data %>% 
  group_by(site) %>% 
  summarise(biomass_sum = sum(biomass_kg_m2))


# group by site and sum mortality and percent
mort_plot <- cuyama_data %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    total_plants = n(),
    plants_alive = sum(mort_status, na.rm = TRUE),
    survival_pct = 100 * mean(mort_status, na.rm = TRUE))


# group by treatment and sum biomass
biomass_treatment <- cuyama_data %>% 
  group_by(treatment) %>% 
  summarise(biomass_sum = sum(biomass_kg_m2))

biomass_site_treatment <- cuyama_data %>% 
  group_by(treatment, site) %>% 
  summarise(biomass_sum = sum(biomass_kg_m2))
# group by treatment and sum mortality 
mort_treatment <- cuyama_data %>% 
  group_by(treatment) %>% 
  summarise(total_plants = n(),
            plants_alive = sum(mort_status, na.rm = TRUE),
            survival_pct = 100 * mean(mort_status,na.rm = TRUE))


# group by species and sum biomass
biomass_species <- cuyama_data %>% 
  group_by(species_id) %>% 
  summarise(biomass_sum = sum(biomass_kg_m2))


# group by species and sum mortality
mortality_species <- cuyama_data %>% 
  group_by(species_id) %>% 
  summarise(total_plants = n(),
            plants_alive = sum(mort_status, na.rm = TRUE),
            survival_pct=100 * mean(mort_status,na.rm = TRUE))


# group by irrigation and biomass/mortality
irrigation <- cuyama_data %>% 
  group_by(irrigation) %>% 
  summarise(biomass_sum = sum(biomass_kg_m2))

irrigation_mort <- cuyama_data %>% 
  group_by(irrigation) %>% 
  summarise(total_plants = n(),
            plants_alive = sum(mort_status, na.rm = TRUE),
            survival_pct = 100 * mean(mort_status, na.rm = TRUE))


# group by site vs biomass/mortality
biomass_mortality_plot <- cuyama_data %>% 
  group_by(site) %>% 
  summarise(total_plants = n(),
            plants_alive = sum(mort_status, na.rm = TRUE),
            survival_pct = 100 * mean(mort_status, na.rm = TRUE),
            biomass_sum = sum(biomass_kg_m2))


# group by species with both avg biomass and % alive
species_biomass_alive <- cuyama_data %>% 
  group_by(species_id) %>% 
  summarise(total_plants = n(),
            plants_alive = sum(mort_status, na.rm = TRUE),
            survival_pct = 100 * mean(mort_status, na.rm = TRUE),
            biomass_sum = sum(biomass_kg_m2))
```


#choosing colors
```{r}
colors()  #to view colors
head(colors(),20)   # to get view sample of names



```



#plotting
```{r}
# Species vs survival
ggplot(data = mortality_species, aes(x = species_id, y = survival_pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Survival Across All Species Planted", 
       x = "Species",
       y = "Percentage Plants Alive")



# Species vs biomass
ggplot(data = biomass_species, aes(x = species_id, y = biomass_sum)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Total Biomass Across All Species Planted",
       x = "Species",
       y = "Total Biomass (kg/m2)")




# Site vs survival
ggplot(data = mort_plot, aes(x = site, y = survival_pct, fill = site)) +
  geom_col() +  
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Condors Hope" = "#9CAF88", "Homegrown" = "khaki", "Riverside Ranch" = "thistle")) +
  labs(title = "Survival Across Sites",
       x = "Site",
       y = "Percentage Plants Alive")



# site vs biomass
ggplot(data = biomass_plot, aes(x = site, y = biomass_sum, fill = site)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Condors Hope" = "#9CAF88", "Homegrown" = "khaki", "Riverside Ranch" = "thistle")) +
  labs(title = "Total Biomass Across Sites",
       x = "Site",
       y = "Total Biomass (kg/m2)")


```



##plotting other ~ not as important data
```{r}
# biomass by treatment and site
ggplot(biomass_site_treatment, aes(x = site,
                                   y = biomass_sum, 
                                   fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge")

# scatterplot biomass/mortality by treatment
ggplot(biomass_mortality_plot, aes(x = survival_pct,
                                   y = biomass_sum)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Plants Alive (%)",
       y = "Total Biomass (kg/m2)")


ggplot(species_biomass_alive, aes(x = plants_alive,
                                  y = biomass_sum,
                                  color = species_id)) +
  geom_point(geom_point(size = 3, shape = 16)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Plants Alive (%)",
       y = "Total Biomass (kg/m2)",
       color = "Species")
